items.headline: Aidan Laughery, Collin Dixon score TDs as Illinois beats Oregon 21-10
items.description: — Aidan Laughery ran for 123 yards and a touchdown and Collin Dixon made a diving catch for a 23-yard score late in the fourth quarter as Illinois defeated Oregon 21-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Illinois QB Katin Houser out 4-6 weeks after hand procedure
items.description: Illinois starting QB Katin Houser will miss four to six weeks after undergoing a procedure on his throwing hand, coach Bret Bielema announced Wednesday.
